services.title: Web Development
services.short: Fast, clear, mobile-first websites that turn visitors into enquiries.
services.hero_title: Websites that work as hard as you do.
services.lead: A website should do a job for your business. We design and build sites that explain what you offer, build trust quickly and make it easy for customers to get in touch.
services.meta: NOVIQ builds fast, responsive, conversion-focused websites and landing pages for small businesses.
includes: Layouts that match your brand and put your main message first.
Designed for phones first, then scaled up for tablets and desktops.
Enquiry forms and buttons placed where customers are ready to act.
Clean structure, page titles and descriptions so search engines understand your pages.
Lightweight code, sensible image sizes and keyboard-friendly navigation.
Simple guidance so you know how to keep your site up to date.
services.for: Small businesses launching a first website, or replacing one that no longer reflects the business.
steps: Discover
We learn your goals, customers and the content you already have.
Design
We shape the layout and visual direction for your approval.
Build
We develop a responsive site and test it across devices.
Launch
We run go-live checks and hand the site over with guidance.

services.title: Social Media Marketing
services.short: Strategy and campaigns that grow the right audience, not just bigger numbers.
services.hero_title: Social media that builds real attention.
services.lead: We plan campaigns around who you want to reach and what you want them to do, then create the content and rhythm to get there.
services.meta: NOVIQ plans social media strategy, campaigns, audience growth and engagement for small businesses.
includes: We define who you want to reach and what success looks like.
Themes and formats that suit your brand and your platforms.
Launches, offers and seasonal moments planned in advance.
Practical tactics to reach new people and keep the ones you have.
Ways to start conversations, not just collect likes.
Regular check-ins to learn what works and improve it.
services.for: Businesses that want a clear plan for social media before committing to daily posting.
steps: Discover
We review your brand, audience and current accounts.
Strategy
We set goals, platforms and content themes.
Create
We produce campaign content and schedules.
Grow
We track results and refine the plan.

services.title: Social Media Management
services.short: Consistent posting and friendly community care, handled for you.
services.lead: We take the day-to-day off your plate: planning, posting and replying, so your accounts stay active and on brand.
services.meta: NOVIQ manages small-business social media: content planning, posting, community management and account optimisation.
includes: A clear plan of what goes out and when, shared with you in advance.
Posts published consistently at sensible times.
Friendly, on-brand replies to comments and messages.
Bios, links, highlights and page details that make a good first impression.
You see and approve content before it goes live.
A plain-language summary of what is working.
services.for: Busy owners who know social media matters but don't have the time to run it.
steps: Discover
We agree your brand voice, accounts and approval process.
Plan
We build a content calendar around your goals.
Post
We create, schedule and publish content.
Care
We reply, monitor and report back.

services.title: Advertising
services.short: Paid campaigns built around a clear goal and tracked from the first click.
services.hero_title: Advertising with a purpose behind every click.
services.lead: We set up and manage digital ad campaigns that are tied to a specific goal, with creative and tracking planned from the start.
services.meta: NOVIQ creates and manages digital advertising campaigns for small businesses, with creative development and performance tracking.
includes: We decide what a good result looks like before spending anything.
Audiences, placements and budgets configured properly.
Ad visuals and copy designed to suit each platform.
We make sure the page people arrive on supports the ad.
Tracking set up so you can see what each campaign delivers.
Regular adjustments based on what the data shows.
services.for: Businesses with a clear offer that are ready to test paid reach.
steps: Discover
We agree the goal, audience and budget.
Strategy
We plan the campaign structure and creative.
Create
We produce ads and set up tracking.
Launch
We go live, monitor and optimise.

services.title: Content Creation
services.short: Graphics, short-form video and creatives that make your brand look ready.
services.hero_title: Content that looks like you mean business.
services.lead: From social graphics to short-form video, we create polished, on-brand content you can use across your website, social channels and ads.
services.meta: NOVIQ creates graphics, short-form video, promotional content and social media creatives for small businesses.
includes: Templates and visuals that keep your look consistent.
Vertical video edits for Reels, Shorts and Stories.
Offers, launches and announcements designed to be noticed.
Post, carousel and story formats sized for each platform.
Guidance for capturing your own photos and clips.
Files organised so you can reuse and adapt them.
services.for: Businesses that need a steady supply of good-looking content but not a full in-house creative team.
steps: Discover
We review your brand and what you need content for.
Concept
We plan formats, styles and messaging.
Create
We design, shoot and edit the content.
Deliver
We hand over files ready to publish.

services.title: Event Planning & Coordination
services.short: From the first idea to the final detail, we coordinate the moving parts of your event so it runs smoothly.
services.hero_title: Plan the experience. We’ll coordinate the details.
services.lead: Whether it’s a business gathering, launch, workshop, celebration or community event, we help turn the idea into a practical plan and keep the moving parts aligned.
services.meta: NOVIQ provides event planning and coordination support, including concepts, schedules, vendor coordination, logistics and on-the-day management.
includes: We shape the purpose, format, timeline and key requirements.
We help coordinate the people and suppliers needed to bring the plan together.
A clear schedule keeps everyone aligned before and during the event.
We plan practical touchpoints that make the event easier for attendees.
We help keep the programme moving while you focus on your guests.
We capture lessons and next steps for future events.
services.for: Businesses, organisations and individuals who want a well-organised event without carrying every detail themselves.
steps: Discover
We understand the event, audience, purpose and priorities.
Plan
We build the timeline, requirements and coordination plan.
Coordinate
We align venues, vendors, people and logistics.
Deliver
We support execution and keep the day moving.

services.title: Event Coverage
services.short: Professional photo and video coverage that turns your event into memories and content you can keep using.
services.hero_title: Don’t let the important moments disappear.
services.lead: We capture the people, atmosphere, key moments and details of your event, then shape the footage and images into polished assets for memories, promotion and social media.
services.meta: NOVIQ provides event photography and video coverage, highlight content and social-ready edits.
includes: Candid and planned images that tell the story of the day.
Professional moving footage of speakers, guests, performances and key moments.
Short, engaging edits designed to preserve the energy of the event.
Vertical clips and selected moments ready for online publishing.
Extra moments that show the work and atmosphere behind the main programme.
Your edited assets are delivered in practical formats for reuse.
services.for: Businesses, organisations, event hosts and brands that want their event professionally documented and turned into useful content.
steps: Brief
We agree the event schedule, coverage priorities and deliverables.
Prepare
We plan positions, timing, equipment and key moments.
Capture
We cover the event with attention to story and detail.
Deliver
We edit and organise the final photos and video assets.

services.title: Business-to-Customer Connections
services.short: We help businesses get in front of people who are more likely to need, trust and act on what they offer.
services.hero_title: Put your business in front of the right people.
services.lead: Visibility alone is not enough. We help connect your offer with relevant audiences through clear positioning, targeted outreach, local visibility and practical enquiry pathways.
services.meta: NOVIQ helps businesses improve customer discovery and connect their offers with relevant audiences through digital and local marketing.
includes: We clarify who your offer is for and what matters to them.
We build campaigns and messages around relevant customer groups.
We help businesses become easier to discover where their customers already search.
Messages are shaped for the people most relevant to the offer.
We make it clear how interested people can take the next step.
We review signals and adjust the approach as results come in.
services.for: Businesses that have a useful product or service but want stronger connections with the customers most relevant to it.
steps: Understand
We learn your offer, market and ideal customer.
Position
We sharpen the message and the reason to choose you.
Connect
We use appropriate channels to reach relevant audiences.
Improve
We track enquiries and refine the connection points.
